first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and prior evidence links both signup friction and onboarding length to activation and time-to-value. Verifying these closely related records will clarify which simplification has the strongest durable-revenue potential. I would run a guarded simplification test while monitoring qualified activation and downstream revenue, since higher completion alone could attract or advance low-value accounts.

final.rationale: Run a guarded SMB onboarding simplification focused on reducing completion friction, prioritizing the shortening approach because it improved completion, time-to-value, and retention. The signup record also showed qualified revenue growth, but its retention decline and SMB-only evidence require monitoring qualified activation, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue before expansion.
